_all: From The Botanical Magazine; or, Flower-Garden Displayed, ed. William Curtis, London, vols 1-4 (1787-1791). Hand-coloured engravings; drawings mostly by Sydenham Edwards (plate 28 and other early plates unsigned), published by W. Curtis, Botanic Garden, Lambeth Marsh. Copy: Missouri Botanical Garden, Peter H. Raven Library, digitised for the Biodiversity Heritage Library. Licence: public domain. Each plate's -bare, -flat and -map files are derived from its scan (see README). The scans are cropped inside the page and white-balanced.
